retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>：王律师, male, middle-aged. Solid heavy frame, thinning hair combed flat over a receding scalp, black tailored suit, white shirt, polished shoes. A stiff posture and a practised half-smile that never reaches his eyes
<Picture 2>：杨父, male, middle-aged. Medium build, slightly stooped, greying temples, deep brow lines, dark wool coat over a plain shirt. Tense shoulders, clenched jaw; a worn working father pushed past his limit.
<Picture 3>：杨希, male, young adult. Slim and upright build, around 180 cm, short black hair, gold-rimmed glasses, white shirt under a dark grey knit cardigan. Quiet, still stance; the first impression is of a composed intellectual.
<Picture 4>：病房, a small hospital ward. Pale green walls; a metal-framed bed by the window, a life-support machine and monitor on a trolley, an IV stand, two green visitor chairs, a low grey cabinet; the window gives onto flat white sky. Its landmark is the bed inside its humming support rig, and the visitor chairs set the room's scale. Sickly neutral white from window and ceiling strip, heavy shadows, desaturated blue-grey cinematic grade. 杨飞飞 lies slack in the bed under a quilt, freshly dyed pink short hair flat on the pillow, one slender hand taped with a line.

detailed_description:
This shot runs 15 seconds. Inside <Picture 4>, <Picture 1> stands in his black suit with both hands folded, walking <Picture 2> through the accident in a flat professional voice while <Picture 2> listens with his arms rigid at his sides; at the midway point <Picture 2> crosses the small room in two steps, fists <Picture 1>'s collar and hauls him up until his heels leave the tile; <Picture 3> watches from a step behind without moving; one narrow overhead light falls on the bed and the floor between them while the rest of the room sinks into shadow, sickly neutral white, shadows short and heavy; desaturated blue-grey Korean-cinema grade; mood isolated and helpless, everything pressed flat.

[Shot 1] A medium shot at eye level frames <Picture 4> from the foot of the bed, <Picture 3> placed at frame right in the foreground with one shoulder half in frame, <Picture 1> and <Picture 2> centre-frame in the mid-ground, <Picture 2> side-on to the camera and <Picture 1> straight on, the two of them an arm's length apart, the green visitor chairs and the low grey cabinet behind them.

[Shot 2] the camera cuts to a close shot on <Picture 1> straight on, <Picture 2>'s fist bunched in his collar and the fabric pulled into hard folds under his chin, <Picture 1>'s expression unmoved as he says: <d>[Chinese]节哀，这种事情谁也没法控制。</d> a bead of sweat runs down <Picture 2>'s temple.

[Shot 3] the shot changes to a close-up on <Picture 2> side-on, the ceiling light cutting under his brow and leaving his eyes dark, spit at the corner of his mouth as he roars: <d>[Chinese]他这是在杀人！</d> his fist twists the collar tighter and <Picture 1>'s collar button snaps loose.

[Shot 4] the camera cuts to an over-the-shoulder shot from behind <Picture 2>, <Picture 1>'s practised half-smile back in place and his breath even, the loose button rolling across the tile toward the bed; <Picture 1> says: <d>[Chinese]但他救了更多的人，不是吗？</d>

[Shot 5] the shot transitions to a medium shot of the whole ward again, <Picture 3> still at frame right with his hands in his pockets, <Picture 1> smoothing his collar flat with two fingers, <Picture 2>'s shoulders rising and falling beside the bed, no one speaking; one hard line of light crosses <Picture 3>'s glasses as he looks at <Picture 1> without a word.

overall_soundscape:
The <Picture 4> runs as the bed: the low steady hum and rhythmic hiss of the life-support machine on its trolley, a ceiling strip buzzing faintly; fabric tearing, a button ticking across the tile, <Picture 2>'s ragged breathing close to mic, level under the dialogue.
